role: MainActor singleton that turns a CapabilityClassifier proposal into a session-sticky tier (Quick/Auto/Deep), owns the shared NaturalLanguage sentence embedder used by the classifier, and enforces a 50/day Tier-3 turn cap persisted in UserDefaults. Also declares the per-conversation RoutingSessionState and the EmbeddingCentroid helper.
types: SmartProviderRouter: final class (@MainActor) — routing + embedder + Tier-3 cap
SmartProviderRouter.Tier: enum (Int, Comparable) — quick=1, auto=2, deep=3
RoutingSessionState: final class (@MainActor) — currentTier + turnCount per conversation, owned by AssistantViewModel
EmbeddingCentroid: enum — mean of embedding vectors
toplevel: contextualEmbedder is a lazy stored property initialised by loadContextualEmbedder(); RoutingSessionState.turnCount = 0. The Tier-3 cap counter lives in UserDefaults (standard), so a relaunch does not reset it.

units.does: Orders tiers by rawValue (quick < auto < deep).

units.does: Classifies the message with CapabilityClassifier, applies sticky-tier rules against the session, logs the decision at .info and returns the chosen tier. Called only from AssistantViewModel routing's proposeTier in Auto mode, which increments turnCount before and stores the result as currentTier after.

Session stickiness: take the proposal if it is an upgrade, or during the settling window (turnCount <= 3: turns 1-3, since the caller counts the current turn first), or if it is Quick with no capability flags; otherwise keep session.currentTier.
